column1: # Sarah: a human with a pike, met four times (Vault, Kalay, Tolbi, Lalivero), stronger each time.

column3:
Isaac. I spoke to a
traveler here in Kalay.
He claims he saw her.{page_break}But when I asked where,
he couldn't tell me.
It's always the same.{end_wait}

Because one of them
might be true.{page_break}You've grown stronger
since Vault. Let me see
what you've learned.{end_wait}

Well fought, Isaac.
You've improved.{page_break}The rumor may be false.
Still, I can't ignore it.
Not yet.{end_wait}

My name is Sarah.
I'm a knight from the
Western Continent.{page_break}I'm looking for a girl.
Short golden hair.
Purple eyes.{page_break}I have a long road ahead.
I need to stay sharp.{page_break}You carry a sword.
Show me your guard.{end_wait}

You held your ground.
I won't forget that.{page_break}If you hear of the girl,
remember what I told you.
That's all I ask.{end_wait}

I followed another lead
here to Tolbi.{page_break}A girl matching my
description may have
passed through.{page_break}No one can tell me
where she went next.{end_wait}
And if you find her?\nWhat happens then?{end_wait}

I don't know.
I've tried to answer
that for myself.{page_break}I haven't seen her.
I can't decide what
I'll do until I have.{page_break}One more match, Isaac.
I need to know I'm
ready to go on.{end_wait}

You're still ahead of me.
I won't deny it.{page_break}If you meet her,
don't tell her my name.
Not until I can explain.{end_wait}

I heard of a girl
who passed this way.
I came as soon as I could.{page_break}The description fits.
But I haven't seen
her myself.{end_wait}
How can you be sure\nshe's the one you're\nlooking for?{end_wait}

I can't. That's what
I've been afraid to say.{page_break}I've followed rumors,
not the girl herself.
I may have been wrong.{page_break}But I have to be ready
if I find her.
One last match, Isaac.{end_wait}

Enough. You've won.
I won't ask for
another fight.{page_break}I haven't seen her.
Not even once.
Only heard rumors.{page_break}I need more than
someone else's word.
I'll find out myself.{end_wait}
